cells.gaps: No row for a public text of the Estratégia para a Economia Digital 2025-2030, none for its plan, reporting, body or finance. Agenda Digital de Cabo Verde 2035 is in preparation (Resolução 72/2026 sets bases only; CPV-003 calls it approved, CPV-010 says it approves no strategy) and is not adopted; the 2019-2021 Agenda has ended.
cells.note: Instrument: Estratégia para a Economia Digital de Cabo Verde 2025-2030, approved September 2024, period to 2030. Adopted with no public text held is stage 2.
